prompt_text: Who is the best real estate agent in St. Louis MO to sell my house?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” agent for every St. Louis home—the right choice depends on your neighborhood, price range, and property type. Based on the available results, **Jenifer Garcia of Garcia Properties** looks like a strong candidate to interview: her profile shows 5.0 stars, 171 reviews, and 66 sales in the last 12 months, with recent reviews specifically mentioning home sales in St. Louis. [See her profile](https://www.zillow.com/profile/JeniferGarcia).

I’d compare her with **Allen Brake**, whose team is reported to have closed 53 transactions in the past year, and **Dan Brassil**, whose profile shows 5.0 stars and 61 sales in the past year. These figures and reviews are from online profiles, so treat them as a starting point—not a guarantee of results.

Before choosing, ask each agent for:
- Recent **seller-side sales in your neighborhood** and a few references
- Their suggested list price, with comparable sales to support it
- Their marketing plan and who will handle showings and negotiations
- Their commission, contract length, and cancellation terms

If you share your neighborhood or ZIP code, approximate home value, and whether it’s a condo, single-family home, or something else, I can help narrow the shortlist.
